entries.mitigation: Get in the water and swim before it detonates. Blocking will not save you.
entries.notes: Rapid Deluge is survived by being in swimming state at detonation; official U34 patch history says it cannot be blocked.

entries.mitigation: Dodge or block the tracked wave. Do not eat it unblocked.
entries.notes: Reviewed veteran evidence records dodge/block as valid responses and says an unblocked hit can be fatal.

entries.mitigation: Stay in healing and heal through the six-second ramping damage window.
entries.notes: Reviewed veteran evidence records a six-second duration, ramping damage, and an explicit heal check.

entries.mitigation: Send the portal team immediately and get the channeler to 50% before the 60-second Dreadsail Ascension wipe.
entries.notes: Current reviewed guide evidence places bridge phases at 50%, 35%, and 20% and gives the channeler team 60 seconds to reach 50% health before the group wipe.

entries.mitigation: Keep stamina available and break free immediately if Lure of the Sea fears you toward the water.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence records two Sirens and a fear/pull mechanic whose response is Break Free.

entries.mitigation: Off-tank the Sea Behemoth and kill it promptly; its dangerous ground areas disappear when it dies.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence says the Sea Behemoth spawns on the main tank, is handled by the off-tank, and its Arctic Annihilation areas disappear on death.

entries.mitigation: Roll-dodge the heavy attack. The dodge creates a low-damage water spout instead of taking the heavy hit.
entries.notes: Current guide labels this heavy attack Coral Slash; FoundryDock keeps the reviewed Coral Slam identity and records the guide naming as source-specific evidence.

entries.mitigation: Keep Taleria faced away from the group. The frontal cone hits twice and refreshes Soaked Wound on targets it catches.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence records a frontal cone, two hits, and a Soaked Wound DoT refreshed by repeated hits.

entries.mitigation: Use the opposite-element dome on the enemy and keep the fire and ice domes from touching. In HM, pair the dome carrier with a separate basher because the carrier cannot bash.
entries.notes: Reviewed dome evidence requires opposite-element protection, records an overload when opposing domes touch, and current HM guide evidence says the carrier cannot bash.

entries.mitigation: Use the opposite-element dome on the enemy and keep the fire and ice domes from touching. In HM, pair the dome carrier with a separate basher because the carrier cannot bash.
entries.notes: Reviewed dome evidence requires opposite-element protection, records an overload when opposing domes touch, and current HM guide evidence says the carrier cannot bash.

entries.mitigation: Pair with one Frostbrand and detonate outside the domes. In HM, make two fire/frost pairs and aim the follow-up line away from the group.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence records one fire/frost pair on veteran, two pairs on HM, and follow-up line AOEs after detonation.

entries.mitigation: Pair with one Firebrand and detonate outside the domes. In HM, make two fire/frost pairs and aim the follow-up line away from the group.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence records one fire/frost pair on veteran, two pairs on HM, and follow-up line AOEs after detonation.

entries.mitigation: Kill the bosses together. After the first dies, finish the second within 15 seconds on veteran or 7.5 seconds on HM.
entries.notes: Current guide evidence says the remaining boss must die before the held domes are dispelled and the side spheres deactivate.

entries.mitigation: Keep the taunt target away from the group while the acid pools drop. Do not stack extra players into it.
entries.notes: Reviewed evidence records the taunt target as the primary target, persistent acid pools, stacking acid vulnerability, and extra pools when additional players are caught.

entries.mitigation: Plan damage around the replication thresholds so new clones do not overlap other mechanics. Veteran: large at 80% and 50%, medium at 50%. HM: large at 100% and 80%, medium at 80%.
entries.notes: Reviewed encounter evidence and current guide data agree on the veteran and hardmode replication thresholds.

entries.mitigation: Kill the Reef Heart before the 60-second timeout or Empowered Rockfall wipes the group.
entries.notes: Reviewed evidence records a 60-second Reef Heart timeout ending in a group wipe from Empowered Rockfall.

entries.mitigation: Send the assigned wind player immediately and heal them to full within 8 seconds. Do not reuse a player while their 60-second wind debuff is active; HM needs two players per wind set.
entries.notes: Reviewed Xynode guide evidence records an 8-second heal window, a roughly one-minute reuse lockout, three assigned players on veteran, and six on HM because two winds occur at once.

entries.mitigation: Move out of the fly-by line. Do not stand in the lingering lightning path; roll through it only if you must cross.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence describes the flight-phase lightning breath as a straight line that persists briefly on the floor.

entries.mitigation: Block the room-wide beam. It cannot be avoided by positioning.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence says the flight-phase ice beam crosses the whole room and an unblocked hit is fatal.

entries.mitigation: Step away from the stack and block your explosion. Do not overlap it with other players.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence records a single targeted spreading AOE that damages nearby players when it resolves.

entries.mitigation: Stay in your assigned stack so the damage is shared. Block the final hit, especially while learning the fight.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence records two simultaneous targets, five ticks, shared stack damage, and a blockable heavy final tick.

entries.mitigation: Keep Flame Atronachs out of the group and kill them quickly. Their death leaves lava; in HM they enrage, charge the group, and explode if left alive.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence records lethal lava on death and an HM enrage/explosion failure state.

entries.mitigation: Back tank holds the Iron Atronachs and blocks their heavies. Burn them when the fire-flight phase makes them molten and vulnerable.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence assigns Iron Atronachs to the back tank and says the fire-flight breath makes them temporarily much easier to kill.

entries.mitigation: Step out of the Time Stop circles before the stun. If caught, Break Free quickly and reform the two stacks.
entries.notes: Reviewed HM guide evidence says Time Stop areas appear near the group and stun players who remain inside.

entries.mitigation: Send three portal players and kill the Eternal Servant before the 90-second timeout. If it survives, it comes upstairs immortal and wipes the group.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence records three portal players, a 90-second timeout, about 3.5-3.6M health on veteran, and about 11.3M on HM.

entries.mitigation: Tank swap when the mark lands. Do not take the next mark while the debuff is active; experienced tanks can dodge the application instead.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence records the tank mark and a fatal repeat hit on veteran while the debuff remains active.

entries.mitigation: Spread for the targeted fire pops, then stack behind a statue for the final room-wide burst. Kill Flame Atronachs immediately.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence records several targeted fire bursts followed by a room-wide final burst that is avoided behind a statue.

entries.mitigation: During portal, assign one upstairs player to trigger Time Stop intentionally so the downstairs team can collect the green damage buff.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence says an upstairs Time Stop trigger creates a green damage-increase circle for the portal group.
